data.name: ALEX RIVERA
data.title: OPERATIONS MANAGER
data.summary: Operations manager with nine years running teams, budgets and day-to-day delivery in healthcare, logistics and retail. Known for fixing slow, error-prone processes and making the fix stick.

roles.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Run day-to-day operations for 12 outpatient clinics with 140 staff and an $18M annual budget.
Cut average patient wait time from 34 to 19 minutes by redesigning check-in and scheduling.
Rolled out a new scheduling system across all 12 sites in five months, on budget.
Hired and coached six clinic leads; four have since been promoted.

roles.title: Operations Supervisor
bullets: Supervised three shifts and 60 warehouse staff; raised on-time shipments from 91% to 98%.
Reduced picking errors by 40% with clearer slotting and a daily five-minute huddle.

roles.title: Operations Coordinator
bullets: Built the inventory reports leadership used for weekly planning.

roles.title: Assistant Store Manager
bullets: Managed scheduling, ordering and training for a 35-person store with $6M in annual sales.

groups.label: Operations
groups.text: Process improvement / Budgeting / Scheduling / Vendor management / KPIs
